result.summary: The page renders largely clean, but the bottom navigation shows an issue: the 'Orders' item is missing its icon, appearing only as text while Home, Search, and Profile have icons. Also, the last content card is cut off mid-card, which is expected scroll behavior but worth noting.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation has no icon, while Home, Search, and Profile all display icons above their labels, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Add the intended Orders/receipt icon above the 'Orders' label, or verify the icon asset loaded correctly.

issues.description: The bottom content card (pizza) is cut off abruptly at the screen edge, partially obscured by the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/scroll margin so the last card is fully visible above the navigation bar.
